title: Product Photo and Video Guides | AIVideosUGC
description: Product photo and video guides for online sellers. Take a clear phone photo, meet Amazon's main-image rules, pick the ad size, and test versions.
h1: Product Photo and Video Guides for Sellers Doing It Themselves
lead: Five short guides, one task at a time. They cover a usable phone photo, a plain-background main image, a first paid video, the right shape (tall, square, or wide), and a fair test.
card: Short how-to guides, from the first photo to the first paid ad.
secondary_keywords: product photography tips for online sellers
how to make product video ads
intro: Each guide ends in a file you download and post yourself. Read the one for the job you are doing today.

A guide can send you to a [template](page:templates) (a ready-made layout), a [product link](page:url-to-video), or a [photo turned into a clip](page:image-to-video). The clip can include a generated presenter from the [actor library](page:ai-actors), a person the tool creates, not a real customer. It can include a script (the words) written from your product. It can include a voiceover (a spoken voice) in the language you sell in, and captions (timed words on the video). You can then post it on TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram). There is no free plan for making files.

steps_h2: How to make product video ads or photos
steps_lead: Take one clear photo, make the file, then post it.

steps.d: Put the product in daylight on a plain surface and take one sharp phone photo.
Upload the photo or paste a product link, pick a template (a ready-made layout), and read the credit cost before you start.
Save the file and post it on TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), or your store. You can sell with it. No logo is stamped on.

faq.q: Do I need a camera or a studio?
faq.a: No. A phone photo in daylight is enough to start. The photo guide shows the setup.

faq.q: Which guide should I read first?
faq.a: If you do not have a clear photo yet, start with the phone-photo guide. If the photo is ready, open the guide for the task you are posting today.

faq.q: Do platform image and ad rules change?
faq.a: Yes. These guides cover the rules sellers meet most often, such as a plain main image and the usual ad sizes. Check that platform's current help page before you launch.

faq.q: How much do the files in the guides cost?
faq.a: There is no free plan. A product photo is 24 credits. A clip is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Credits are what you spend to make a file. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 a month for 300. Premium is $63 a month for 600. The exact cost is shown before you start. If a file does not finish, its credits come back.

faq.q: Can one phone photo be used for every guide?
faq.a: Yes, if the photo shows the whole item clearly. You can make a photo from it and a clip from it. They are separate files.

faq.q: Can I add captions and music later?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for captions, timed words, or a spoken voice in the clip. Or add a price and music you have the rights to use after you download. The download has no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file.

faq.q: Where do I make the file after I read a guide?
faq.a: On the page that guide points to. The guide tells you how to do the task. That page is where you upload the photo and make the file.

faq.q: Can I follow these if I have never run an ad?
faq.a: Yes. You need a phone photo, not a studio. The first-ad guide stops at a file you can post. Setting up the ad account stays in that platform's own help pages.

faq.q: Do the guides cover an AI presenter, a script, and a spoken voice?
faq.a: Yes. The video guides send you to a generated presenter from the actor library. They also cover a script written from your product or your link, and a spoken voice in the language you sell in.

faq.q: Can I post the file on TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram)?
faq.a: Yes. Make the shape that platform uses, then post it there. The [platform pages](page:platforms) list the usual shapes, such as tall, square, and wide.

faq.q: Which kinds of shops are the guides for?
faq.a: The photo steps and the video steps are the same kind of task for every kind of shop. Rules differ by product type, so check the [page for your kind of shop](page:industries) before you upload.

faq.q: Why read a guide instead of starting from an empty form?
faq.a: The guide names the one task, the file you should end with, and the checks to make before you spend credits on a second try.
